My research focuses on climate variability, climate extremes, Earth system modelling, and the application of artificial intelligence to climate science. The publications below are organised by research theme.

---

# 🌊 Ocean–Atmosphere Interactions

Research on Atlantic variability, the Atlantic Niño, and West African climate. 


These three articles are the core of my PhD research.

::: {.publication-card}

### Future changes in the mean and variability of extreme rainfall indices over the Guinea Coast and role of the Atlantic equatorial mode

@Worou_2023

Projected changes in Guinea Coast rainfall extremes under climate change, highlighting the influence of the Atlantic Niño.

:::

::: {.publication-card}

### Weakened impact of the Atlantic Niño on the future equatorial Atlantic and Guinea Coast rainfall

@Worou_2022

Analysis of how climate change modifies the Atlantic Niño teleconnection and its influence on Guinea Coast rainfall.

:::

::: {.publication-card}

### Interannual variability of rainfall in the Guinean Coast region and its links with sea surface temperature changes

@Worou_2020

Study of rainfall variability over the Guinea Coast and its relationship with tropical Atlantic sea surface temperatures.

:::
